title: Smooth polynomial features in Gaussian L²
source_anchor: F1 in source-only.json; proof topology P1, P2.
target_statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. For every real polynomial \(p\) and every \(w\in E\), the literal function \(x\mapsto p(\langle w,x\rangle)\) belongs to \(L^2(\gamma_E)\). Its equivalence-class map is globally \(C^\infty\) on all of \(E\). The membership witnesses are produced by the proof and used to form these actual classes.

binder_audit.meaning: Concrete finite-dimensional real Borel inner-product carrier.

For every finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space E with its Borel structure and every real polynomial p, each literal ridge x -> p(<w,x>) belongs to L2(gamma_E). There exists a family h(w) of those membership proofs such that w -> (h(w)).toLp of that literal function is globally C-infinity on all of E into L2(gamma_E). No unit-vector, degree, coefficient or derivative bound is assumed.
